latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the patent-value-analysis skill (V1.0).
- Provides automated multi-dimensional patent value assessment based on user-supplied patent name.
- Generates a comprehensive report including patent basic information, five-dimension radar chart (technical, legal, market, economic, strategic), and overall value score.
- Offers legal stability scoring, technical maturity evaluation, remaining economic life prediction, and market value estimation.
- Includes actionable conversion and financial matching suggestions based on evaluation results.
